# Description

Provide a detailed summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them. Include references to any related issues or discussions.

Fixes # (issue number)

## Type of Change

Please mark with an `x` the options that apply to this pull request:

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation Update (modifications to guides, readmes, or inline comments)
- [ ] 🧪 Test addition or validation workflow enhancement
- [ ] 🎨 Style / Formatting improvements (non-functional code cleanups)

## Scope and Impact

Describe the specific modules or components impacted by this change. Ensure that changes are focused and do not include unrelated modifications.

## Validation & Testing

Explain the steps you took to verify your changes. Include details about your environment, local testing procedures, and browser responsiveness verification.

### Checklist

- [ ] Code compiles successfully locally (`npm run build` or python compile)
- [ ] Tested responsiveness on multiple viewports (Mobile, Tablet, Desktop)
- [ ] Follows the styling and naming conventions of the repository
- [ ] Accessibility standards (aria-labels, keyboard navigation) have been considered
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive configuration values are exposed

## Screenshots / Visual Demonstrations

*For UI/UX modifications, please paste images, GIFs, or visual comparative previews here.*
